label: MikroTik hAP ax lite
description: Compact Wi-Fi 6 router: 4x 1G and a single 2.4 GHz 802.11ax radio at 574 Mbit/s.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 4x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, 2.4 GHz max data rate 574 Mbit/s (802.11ax). **Single band** - there is no 5 GHz radio, so the spec carries one wlan interface and a lab cannot put this device on a 5 GHz channel.
